results.name: Merton libraries

rows.title: Mariesa Dulak: Tigers, Trains and Crocodiles
rows.description: Wimbledon BookFest event All aboard for an extraordinary morning with award-winning children’s author Mariesa Dulak. Get ready for a lively, interactive adventure packed with story time, nursery rhymes, animal actions, sing-alongs and a dance to finish. Join the creator of the much-loved There’s a Tiger on the Train, winner of the FAB Prize and The Week Junior Award for Best Picture Book of the Year for a joyful celebration of stories, imagination and the magic of picture books. £12.50 Under 12s: £7.50 Limited number of free tickets to residents in postcodes CR4, CR7, SM3 and SM4 (restricted to two free tickets per event, per household). Aged 16-29? Sign up for £10 tickets and no booking fee! *Enter your date of birth when you sign up. £10 tickets subject to availability Contact: info@wimbledonbookfest.org To book: https://www.wimbledonbookfest.org/events/mariesa-dulak/ Booking required

rows.title: Rhymetime
rows.description: Join us every Monday for songs with Nick and his guitar Please book 1 ticket per child Please note: Customers will be required to enter the library using their Adult library card or Merton Libraries app and PIN number during the following opening hours: Weekdays, 8am-1pm Customers can apply for a library card on our website www.merton.gov.uk/libraries and collect it from the library (Monday – Friday, 9.30am-1pm and Saturdays, 9.30am-5pm). Please note that to respect the privacy of families, we ask that no photos or video are taken at any of our children’s events. It’s very likely that another child will be in the picture/shot. Thank you for your co-operation.  Booking required

rows.title: Homework Club
rows.description: Free homework help during term-time with volunteers on hand to help your child with their homework. Children benefit from a space to study, access to a wide selection of books and internet access. Please note, our volunteers provide support and not all are trained teachers. Parental supervision is required. For more information and to book, please contact library staff on 02082745789, or via e-mail at library.westbarnes@merton.gov.uk  Booking required

rows.title: Reading Eggs Phonics Session Wimbledon
rows.description: Come and join us at Wimbledon library for this free 45-minute group session exploring Reading Eggs. Reading eggs supports children's learning by offering bespoke online lessons tailored to their own individual level. The lessons allow them to progress at their own pace, and build confidence through rewards and achievements. PLEASE MAKE SURE YOUR CHILD HAS A READING EGGS ACCOUNT BEFORE ATTENDING THE SESSION. PLEASE VISIT YOUR LOCAL MERTON LIBRARY TO SIGN UP FOR FREE. Please bring you own device in order to access the Reading Eggs programme. We recommend bringing headphones to make it easier to hear the audio aspects of the lessons (particularly the phonics). Booking is essential. Term Time Only.  Booking required

rows.title: Story and Song with Cricket Green
rows.description: Cricket Green School for Diverse and Complex Special Needs has teamed up with Mitcham Library to offer a fun session for parents and young children. Join us every term time Tuesday for story time, activities and songs.  Booking required

rows.title: Tuesday Craft Club: Mavis Pusey
rows.description: Join in the fun with this weekly children's craft session - ideal for ages 5-11! This week we'll be doing an art activity in the style of abstract artist Mavis Pusey Please note that to respect the privacy of families, we ask that no photos or video are taken at any of our children’s events. It’s very likely that another child will be in the picture/shot. Thank you for your co-operation.  Booking required

rows.title: Storytime
rows.description: These sessions are suitable for children aged 0-5. Storytime is a fun way to introduce your child to books, stimulates their imagination and is a great way for your child to make new friends. To respect the privacy of all families attending, we kindly ask that no photos or videos are taken during any of our children’s events. It is very likely that other children will appear in any images or recordings. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Due to essential building maintenance, our Children's Library currently has limited space. If you wish to attend, please book a ticket for each adult and child attending.  Booking required

rows.title: Rhymetime with Nick
rows.description: Everyone's favourite rhymetime! Come and join us for half an hour of laugh-out-loud fun with Nick an his guitar. Please note that to respect the privacy of families, we ask that no photos or video are taken at any of our children’s events.  Booking required

rows.title: Morden Library Thursday Story & Rhyme Time (0-5 Years)
rows.description: These sessions are suitable for children aged 2-5. Storytime is a fun way to introduce your child to books, stimulates their imagination and is a great way for your child to make new friends. PLEASE NOTE: Our children's activities are very popular and get fully booked quite quickly. If you book a ticket and then can no longer attend the session, please cancel your tickets to make the space available to someone else. *Please note that to respect the privacy of families, we ask that no photos or video are taken at any of our children’s events. It’s very likely that another child will be in the picture/shot. Thank you for your co-operation.  Booking required

rows.title: Rhymetime with Nick
rows.description: Everyone's favourite rhymetime, now also at Morden Library! Come and join us for half an hour of laugh-out-loud fun with Nick an his guitar. Please note that to respect the privacy of families, we ask that no photos or video are taken at any of our children’s events.  Booking required

rows.title: Homework Club
rows.description: Free homework help during term-time with volunteers on hand to help your child with their homework. Children benefit from a space to study, access to a wide selection of books and internet access. Please note, our volunteers provide support and not all are trained teachers. Parental supervision is required.  Booking required

rows.title: Special Educational Needs & Disabilities Stay and Play Session
rows.description: Stay and Play sessions are a chance for children with sensory needs to be able to play with our wide selection of SEND toys, switches and equipment as well as all of the other sensory equipment in the children’s library.  Booking required

rows.title: Music Mayhem
rows.description: Come along and join Lindsay every Monday morning for Music Mayhem ; a fun music filled session for little ones under 5 years old. Listen to well known children's rhymes and songs and have a go at joining it too! Spaces are limited and booking is required to be able to participate. Booking is 1 ticket per child. PLEASE NOTE: During this time, Libraries Plus will be in operation and the library may be unstaffed. You WILL need an adult library card and pin to access the library between 8am and 1pm. Please note that to respect the privacy of families, we ask that no photos or video are taken at any of our children’s events . It’s very likely that another child will be in the picture/shot. Thank you for your co-operation. Our storytime/rhymetime sessions are very popular and get fully booked quite quickly. If you book a ticket and later on cannot longer attend the session, we’d be grateful if you could cancel your order so it can become available to someone else. The following week's sessio

rows.title: Reading Eggs Phonics Session for Get Online Week
rows.description: GET ONLINE WEEK: HAVE A CRACK AT READING EGGS! Come along to the library during Get Online Week and discover Reading Eggs , a fun online learning programme for children. Explore fun reading activities Build reading skills and confidence Learn through games and activities Discover how learning online can be fun 🐣 Crack open a world of reading! PLEASE MAKE SURE YOUR CHILD HAS A READING EGGS ACCOUNT BEFORE ATTENDING THE SESSION. PLEASE VISIT YOUR LOCAL MERTON LIBRARY TO SIGN UP FOR FREE. Please bring you own device in order to access the Reading Eggs programme. We recommend bringing headphones to make it easier to hear the audio aspects of the lessons (particularly the phonics). Booking is essential. Term Time Only.  Booking required

rows.title: Rhymetime in Sutton Central Library
rows.description: Our ever popular Rhymetimes are here for children aged 0-5 to enjoy singing and stories with Sutton Council's Cultural Services, the people behind your local libraries and heritage houses. Please book a ticket for each child and adult wanting to attend. Children must be accompanied by a responsible adult throughout. This event may be photographed and/or recorded for marketing and evaluation purposes. If you do not wish to be a part of future promotional material, please make it known at the time of the event. Please log in with your library credentials to reserve your place at this event.
